notes: NICE CKS pages were not returned (only NICE MIB46, whose text was retrieved and is now cited for antibiotics, swab and ophthalmology referral). Newborn advice: NHS says urgent appointment for under 30 days (NHS inform says 28 days and optometrist); route stated as urgent GP appointment, NHS 111 out of hours is not separately sourced for babies. 999 deliberately not named: no returned source for adult conjunctivitis says it. Moorfields school advice vs NHS/UKHSA (no exclusion) not reconciled; only UKHSA/NHS stated. Removed: hay fever links, sexual-health referral, stringy discharge, widened vessels, 24 hours, 1-2 weeks, droplets, hot-wash, eye-drop sharing, PMC-sourced sight-threatening claim. Terms suffix-itis and root-ophthalm and alias 'red eye infection' removed. Symptom link 'swelling' kept (MedlinePlus lists swelling; Moorfields eyelid swelling). 'hospital eye service' gloss and the clinician/pharmacist drop-decision sentence are textbook. Some wording (cool compress, mould) rests on blended search summaries of the cited pages.
